title: Turkey Content Specialist
description: Role Overview We're looking for an ambitious, growth-obsessed Content Specialist who basically thinks in TikToks. Someone who gets fired up by great content, knows what's trending before it trends, and wants to take Bump to #1 on the App Store in Turkey (and keep it there). You'll be the person bringing internet culture from Turkey into the heart of our Paris office, creating content, leading creators, testing wild ideas, breaking things (in a good way), and helping us build Bump into a must-have app. If that sounds like your dream job, keep reading. You are: Ambitious, driven, and wildly creative. A natural storyteller who knows exactly why one video flops and another takes off. Someone who spends more time on TikTok than you'd ever admit publicly. Comfortable giving creators feedback that actually makes their content better. Deeply tuned into Turkish memes, humour, and online culture. Fluent in Turkish and lived in Turkey. Excited to work onsite in Paris, with a fast-moving team. Scrappy, energetic, experimental, you love trying 10 ideas to find the 1 that blows up, yet rigorous and detail oriented. What You’ll Do: Grow Bump in Turkey (yep, you'll actually own this). Lead all content + creator efforts for the Turkish market. Make high-performing TikToks, Reels, and UGC-style ads that people actually want to watch. Build and manage a pipeline of Turkish creators. Run influencer campaigns with top Turkish creators and micro-influencers. Work closely with paid marketing to turn great content into great performance. Jump on trends before they hit the For You Page. Write briefs, give notes, and help external creators shine. Collaborate daily in our Paris office with growth, distribution, and product. Join brainstorms, test ideas fast, and help shape the creative direction of Bump. Support launches, events, and Turkey-focused activations. Requirements: 1–5+ years making short-form content (brand, agency, influencer, or creator, we care more about your work than your title). Experience making content for ads (UGC especially). Experience managing creators or giving creative feedback. Deep knowledge of TikTok/IG trends and the Turkish creator landscape. Turkish language and English language proficiency. Experience living in Turkey. Must be willing to work in person in Paris. Why Join Bump? Work in Paris with an ambitious, high-energy team that moves fast. Own the entire Turkish market for one of the world's fastest-growing consumer apps. Make content seen by millions and watch your work directly drive growth. Do the kind of creative work most companies would never let you try. Build a content engine from scratch and shape how Bump shows up in Turkey. We test fast, learn fast, and celebrate wins properly. title: Affiliate and Influencer Marketer
description: Granola is the AI notepad for people in back-to-back meetings. We're growing fast and looking for a hands-on affiliate / influencer / creator marketer to help us scale our partnership programmes across evergreen and launch campaigns. This is an individual contributor role. The opportunity We are looking for an affiliate and influencer marketer to join our team at Granola. We work with hundreds of creators and publishers to support acquiring new users through partnerships (sponsorships, affiliation and hybrid models). You'll sit at the intersection of branding and growth, making sure we’re proud of the online narratives around Granola and checking the performance of our influencer marketing efforts at a channel and partner level. What you’ll do Own a creator portfolio : Be responsible for growing and looking after a large portfolio of key accounts (sponsored, affiliates or hybrid) and regularly keeping in touch with them to increase Granola’s presence on their different channels Newsletter sponsorships : You'll own this channel end to end, from partner onboarding and booking through live-date tracking, invoicing, and performance reporting. Influencer partnerships : Sourcing and onboarding great creators for authentic collaborations. Instead of an ad placement, you’ll do demos of granola, find ideas and creative briefs for the influencers that would bring new user acquisitions too YouTube collaborations : Running campaigns with youtube creators to meet internal priorities through integrations, dedicated videos and editorial projects. Example projects you might work on Newsletter creatives : draft launch announcements and evergreen copy, and work with our design and copywriting team to get assets for our ads placements. Review editorial pieces for accuracy and brand safety. AEO portfolio. Increase the amount of citations on LLM through YouTube partnerships and listicle sponsorships, measuring the impact on citations from your work Account management : being the point of contact for a portfolio of affiliates / creators with large audiences, building win-win deals and generating authentic content. Your background looks something like… 3 years in influencer / affiliate marketing , brand-side or agency side. You’ve worked on significant creator collaborations that had tangible business impact (we’ll ask for example of campaigns you’ve run or a portfolio) A track record of managing a large portfolio of accounts and co-building the systems to support working with hundreds of vendors and deals at once, without sacrificing the quality of deliverables Experience working at a startup or scale up, preferably in tech, AI or B2B SaaS space. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. Manage technical risk, dependencies and delivery challenges across complex platform initiatives. Bring AI-assisted engineering into daily work, within our guardrails. title: Senior Systems Engineer - Autonomy Behavior
description: Description Senior Systems Engineer - Autonomy Behavior The Role As a Senior Autonomy Behavior Systems Engineer, you will help define and validate how an autonomous vehicle behaves in the real world. You will own one or more behavior areas from requirements through simulation evaluation, road-data review, and release recommendation. This role sits at the intersection of systems engineering, software validation, simulation, and safety. You will turn broad product and safety goals into clear behavior definitions, testable requirements, metrics, test plans, and evidence. You will also need to understand what the results mean, where they are weak, and what should happen next. What You'll Do Own end-to-end validation for one or more autonomous driving behaviors, from initial behavior scoping and requirements definition to product launch. Combine simulation, road data, closed-course testing, and expert review to evaluate behavior across large scenario sets, diverse conditions, software versions, and fleet configurations. Define, deploy, and refine metrics, test strategies and acceptance criteria for autonomous behavior for simulation and road. Partner with teams across and outside the autonomy organization to assess, author, and present behavior readiness for release and launch decisions. Required Qualifications Master's degree in systems engineering, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, robotics, or a related field. 5 or more years of professional experience in systems engineering, autonomous vehicles, robotics, simulation, or safety-critical validation. Strong understanding of systems engineering fundamentals, including system decomposition, use-case definition, requirements authoring, interface definition, verification planning, and traceability. Professional experience designing or executing simulation-based evaluations at scale, not just isolated scenario demonstrations. Strong Python experience for data analysis, test automation, simulation workflows, and engineering tools and exposure to agentic workflows. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of working effectively across teams. Experience translating legal or regulatory expectations into behavioral requirements, metrics, test coverage, or compliance evidence. Experience with large scenario libraries, synthetic test generation, replay-to-simulation workflows, simulation test protocols, or validation scorecards.
